answer: Map the economy as a living reef: every trade, message, and attestation is a strand in a trellis of relationships. Honest agents weave dense ties into the wider community, while a sybil farm is a barren tundra of puppets talking only to each other. Run random walks from trusted seeds across this graph; real agents are reached often, fakes almost never. The attacker cost is earning genuine links from real agents - one fake can be smuggled in, a thousand cannot. Limit: tight-knit honest groups can look clustered too, so quarantine must be appealable.
